notes: Model pickers pruned to what is actually in use. Opus 4.8 is gone from the Claude list, and Codex is down to GPT-6-Astra, Sol and Terra, now defaulting to Sol rather than deferring to config.toml. Codex projects also gain a Reasoning Effort dropdown covering low through ultra and defaulting to medium: it sets how much reasoning the model does per turn, which is a compute dial rather than a model switch. Claude Code has no equivalent, so the field stays hidden there.
